test_cases.title: Start of Mission tetikleyicisiyle iletişim oturumu başlatma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2 modunda ve Start of Mission tetikleyicisi için gerekli koşullar sağlanmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start of Mission komutu.

steps.action: Start of Mission tetikleyicisi uygulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4'te tanımlanan kısıtlamaları gözlemleyerek bir iletişim oturumu başlatma sürecini başlatır.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu ve oturum başlatma sıralaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, iletişim oturumu başlatma tetikleyicisi almıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen sistem versiyonu mesajı.

steps.action: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir.
steps.expected: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteği iletilir.

steps.action: Bağlantı kurulduktan sonra OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajını gönderir.
steps.expected: Oturum başlatma mesajı RBC'ye iletilir.

steps.action: RBC'den uyumlu bir sistem versiyonu alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumun kurulduğunu kabul eder ve 'session established report' mesajını gönderir.

test_cases.title: Uyumlu olmayan sistem versiyonu durumunda oturum sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, iletişim oturumu başlatma sürecindedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen uyumsuz sistem versiyonu mesajı.

steps.action: RBC'den uyumlu olmayan bir sistem versiyonu alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, 'No compatible version supported' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: Sürücüye bilgi verilir ve oturum sonlandırılır.
steps.expected: Sürücüye uyumsuzluk bildirimi yapılır ve iletişim oturumu kapatılır.

test_cases.title: Radyo sistemi seçimi: Trackside emri önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem GSM-R hem de FRMCS radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Trackside emri, FRMCS-only RBC'ye bağılmayı gerektirir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside emri (FRMCS-only RBC hedefi).

steps.action: Trackside emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.7.1 öncelik sırasına göre FRMCS radyo sistemini seçer ve güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir.

test_cases.title: Radyo sistemi seçimi: Sürücü tercihi önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem GSM-R hem de FRMCS radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Trackside emri yoktur. Sürücü, Start of Mission sırasında GSM-R'yi seçmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start of Mission tetikleyicisi.

steps.action: Start of Mission tetikleyicisi uygulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, trackside emri olmadığı için sürücünün Start of Mission'daki tek radyo tercihine (GSM-R) göre hareket eder ve GSM-R ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir.

test_cases.title: Radyo sistemi seçimi: Kayıtlı Radio Network bilgisi önceliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem GSM-R hem de FRMCS radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. Trackside emri yoktur. Sürücü tercihi yapılmamıştır. Kayıtlı Radio Network bilgisi FRMCS'i tercih etmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Start of Mission tetikleyicisi.

steps.action: Start of Mission tetikleyicisi uygulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, trackside emri ve sürücü tercihi olmadığı için kayıtlı Radio Network bilgisi ve tercih edilen radyo sistemine (FRMCS) göre hareket eder ve FRMCS ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için istek gönderir.

test_cases.title: Başarılı radyo sisteminin hafızaya kaydedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem GSM-R hem de FRMCS radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. OBU, GSM-R ile güvenli radyo bağlantısını başarıyla kurmuştur.

steps.action: GSM-R ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı başarıyla kurulduktan sonra OBU'nun hafızası incelenir.
steps.expected: OBU, başarılı kurulumda kullanılan radyo sistemini (GSM-R) hafızasına kaydeder.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında desk closure ile iptal
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Start of Mission tetikleyicisiyle iletişim oturumu kurulum sürecindedir (güvenli radyo bağlantısı isteği gönderilmiş, sistem versiyonu henüz alınmamış).
test_cases.test_inputs: Desk closure emri.

steps.action: Start of Mission sırasında desk closure emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, iletişim oturumu kurulumunu iptal eder ve mevcut güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında End of Mission ile iptal
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, iletişim oturumu kurulum sürecindedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: End of Mission emri.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu sırasında End of Mission emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, iletişim oturumu kurulumunu iptal eder ve mevcut güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında trackside sonlandırma emriyle iptal
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, iletişim oturumu kurulum sürecindedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sonlandırma emri.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu sırasında trackside sonlandırma emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, iletişim oturumu kurulumunu iptal eder ve mevcut güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sırasında Level 2 çıkış geçişiyle iptal
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, iletişim oturumu kurulum sürecindedir. Araç, min safe rear end ile Level 2 çıkış noktasına yaklaşmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Araç hareketi (Level 2 çıkış geçişi).

steps.action: Min safe rear end, Level 2 çıkış noktasını geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, iletişim oturumu kurulumunu iptal eder ve mevcut güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Son bilinen RBC kimliği ile trackside emri işleme
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da kayıtlı RBC iletişim bilgileri mevcuttur. Trackside emri, 'son bilinen RBC' özel kimlik değerini taşımaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside emri (son bilinen RBC kimliği, farklı bir telefon numarası ile).

steps.action: Trackside emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, emirdeki telefon numarasını görmezden gelir ve kayıtlı RBC iletişim bilgilerini kullanarak RBC'ye bağılır.

test_cases.title: Kayıtlı RBC bilgisi yokken son bilinen RBC emrini yok sayma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da kayıtlı RBC iletişim bilgileri yoktur. Trackside emri, 'son bilinen RBC' özel kimlik değerini taşımaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside emri (son bilinen RBC kimliği).

steps.action: Trackside emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, emri yok sayar ve iletişim oturumu başlatmaz.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (state: Establishing).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for Start of Mission in Level 2.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-A is the target RBC for the Start of Mission.

steps.action: Initiate Start of Mission in Level 2 targeting RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new communication session establishment procedure with RBC-A. The existing establishment process continues.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment after session established
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Manual selection of RBC contact information for RBC-A by the driver.
test_cases.assumptions: Driver manually selects RBC-A contact info outside of Start of Mission.

steps.action: Driver manually selects RBC-A contact information.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing new session with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions.
test_cases.test_inputs: Order from trackside to establish session with RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is different from RBC-A.

steps.action: Receive order from trackside to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior after termination.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: RBC transition order with Accepting RBC does not terminate current session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A (currently supervising) is established and active. OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is the Accepting RBC in the transition order.

steps.action: Receive RBC transition order with embedded order to establish session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT terminate the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior regarding RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates establishment of a communication session with RBC-B while maintaining the session with RBC-A.

test_cases.title: Exception: RBC transition order with single-session capability terminates current session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A (currently supervising) is established and active. OBU is configured to handle only one communication session through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-B is the Accepting RBC. OBU hardware/software limitation restricts it to one active GSM-R session.

steps.action: Receive RBC transition order with embedded order to establish session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior after termination.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates establishment of a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information in Sleeping mode (nominal direction)
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data containing: 1) Info valid for both directions, 2) Info valid for Nominal direction only, 3) Info valid for Reverse direction only.
test_cases.assumptions: The referenced balise group is crossed in the nominal direction.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Nominal direction while in SL mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid for both directions.

steps.action: Check handling of Nominal-only information.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid for the Nominal direction (crossing direction).

steps.action: Check handling of Reverse-only information.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information valid only for the Reverse direction (opposite to crossing direction).

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information in Shunting mode (reverse direction)
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group data containing: 1) Info valid for both directions, 2) Info valid for Reverse direction only, 3) Info valid for Nominal direction only.
test_cases.assumptions: The referenced balise group is crossed in the reverse direction.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Reverse direction while in SH mode.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid for both directions.

steps.action: Check handling of Reverse-only information.
steps.expected: The OBU takes into account the information valid for the Reverse direction (crossing direction).

steps.action: Check handling of Nominal-only information.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information valid only for the Nominal direction (opposite to crossing direction).

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence and immediate request on new parameter receipt
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. OBU has received MA request parameters from RBC: Repeat=Yes, Period=10s. Last MA request was sent 12 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repeat=Yes, Period=5s.
test_cases.assumptions: The time since the last MA request (12s) is greater than or equal to the newly received repetition period (5s).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from RBC (Period=5s).
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior immediately after receiving new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request immediately because the time since the last request (12s) >= new period (5s).

test_cases.title: MA request parameters persistence without immediate request
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. OBU has received MA request parameters from RBC: Repeat=Yes, Period=10s. Last MA request was sent 2 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repeat=Yes, Period=5s.
test_cases.assumptions: The time since the last MA request (2s) is less than the newly received repetition period (5s).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from RBC (Period=5s).
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones immediately.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior immediately after receiving new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT send an MA request immediately. It waits for the new repetition period (5s) to elapse from the last request.

test_cases.title: No Supervised Location defined while supervising Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LoA) with target speed > 0. The train is approaching the end of the overlap, which is a candidate for Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data indicating approach to end of overlap.
test_cases.assumptions: The end of overlap is a valid SvL candidate per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5.1.

steps.action: Move the train towards the end of the overlap while supervising the LoA.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define the end of the overlap as a Supervised Location (SvL).

steps.action: Check OBU internal state for SvL definition.
steps.expected: No SvL is active or defined on board while the LoA is being supervised.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction remains valid until new restriction received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is active and valid.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new speed restriction received.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving within the area of validity of the 80 km/h restriction.

steps.action: Continue operation in Level 1 without receiving a new speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h speed restriction.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction replaced by new restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is active and valid.
test_cases.test_inputs: New signalling related speed restriction of 60 km/h received from trackside.
test_cases.assumptions: The new restriction is received directly (not via infill).

steps.action: Receive the new 60 km/h speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the 80 km/h restriction with the 60 km/h restriction immediately upon receipt.

steps.action: Check applied speed limit.
steps.expected: The OBU now applies the 60 km/h speed restriction.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction remains valid after switch to Level 2 until MA accepted
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is active and valid. OBU switches to Level 2 mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Level 2 MA not yet accepted.
test_cases.assumptions: The switch to Level 2 is initiated, but no Level 2 MA has been accepted yet.

steps.action: Switch OBU from Level 1 to Level 2 mode.
steps.expected: The 80 km/h signalling related speed restriction remains valid.

steps.action: Check applied speed limit before Level 2 MA acceptance.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the 80 km/h speed restriction.

test_cases.title: Maximum train speed defined as Static Speed Restriction category
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in any mode. Train configuration and performance data are available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Maximum train speed value set to 200 km/h based on train performance.
test_cases.assumptions: The train's actual performance allows a maximum speed of 200 km/h.

steps.action: Define the maximum train speed as 200 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the value and handles it as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction.

steps.action: Check internal speed restriction list.
steps.expected: The 200 km/h value is present in the Static Speed Restriction list under the Maximum Train Speed category.

test_cases.title: Initial state: No permitted braking distance speed restriction applied
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in its initial state. No permitted braking distance data has been received from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: None.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has just been powered on or reset to initial state.

steps.action: Check OBU speed restriction status in initial state.
steps.expected: The OBU considers that no permitted-braking-distance speed restriction applies.

steps.action: Check if any speed limit is constrained by permitted braking distance.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Safe radio connection loss triggers immediate reconnection attempt
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A safe radio connection is established with a specific radio system (e.g., GSM-R). EURORADIO is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system previously used for the successful connection is available and reachable.

steps.action: Establish a safe radio connection between OBU and the radio system.
steps.expected: OBU status indicates an active safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO.
steps.expected: OBU immediately initiates an attempt to set up a new safe radio connection with the same radio system.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A communication session is established. Safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated radio interference preventing connection for a short duration, followed by restoration of radio availability.
test_cases.assumptions: The communication session is not terminated and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Cause the loss of the safe radio connection during an active session.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Keep the radio system unavailable for a defined period (e.g., 10 seconds) to cause failed reconnection attempts.
steps.expected: OBU continues to repeat reconnection attempts without stopping.

steps.action: Restore radio system availability.
steps.expected: OBU successfully establishes a new safe radio connection and stops repeating attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A communication session is established. Safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to terminate the communication session.
test_cases.assumptions: The train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Cause the loss of the safe radio connection during an active session.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Issue a command to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating reconnection attempts and regards the session as terminated.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A communication session is established with an RIU order specifying a termination location. Safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement data simulating passage of the RIU termination location.
test_cases.assumptions: The communication session is not otherwise terminated.

steps.action: Cause the loss of the safe radio connection during an active session.
steps.expected: OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location given in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: OBU initiates termination upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends a 'Termination of Communication Session' order.

steps.action: The trackside sends a termination order to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU does not initiate termination without trackside order or condition
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. No termination conditions from SUBSET-026 are fulfilled.
test_cases.test_inputs: No trackside order is sent. No termination condition is triggered.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time without any trackside order or termination condition.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU repeats termination message if no acknowledgement is received
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has initiated the termination of the communication session and sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement is received from the trackside within the fixed waiting time.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time is defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
steps.expected: The OBU waits for the fixed waiting time.

steps.action: The fixed waiting time expires without an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

test_cases.title: OBU considers session terminated after maximum repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating the communication session and has been repeating the termination message.
test_cases.test_inputs: No acknowledgement is received after the last allowed repetition.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined number of repetitions is taken from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message for the defined maximum number of times.
steps.expected: The OBU waits for the fixed waiting time after the last sending.

steps.action: The fixed waiting time expires without an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated.

test_cases.title: Güç açıldığında GSM-R kayıt talebinin gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU kapalı durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ve çalışır durumdadır.
test_cases.assumptions: GSM-R ağının mevcut olduğu varsayılır.

steps.action: OBU güç açma komutuyla başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlı GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kaydolması için bir kayıt talebi (registration request) gönderir.

test_cases.title: Sürücünün yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girmesi üzerine kayıt talebi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır. Mevcut kayıt farklı bir ağ kimliği içindir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği (PLMN ID).

steps.action: Sürücü arayüzünden yeni bir GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girilir ve onaylanır.
steps.expected: OBU, GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in yeni girilen kimliğe sahip GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kaydolması için bir kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Yol kenarı komutu üzerine GSM-R kayıt talebi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yol kenarından gelen kayıt komutu (trackside order).

steps.action: Yol kenarı sisteminden OBU'ya GSM-R kayıt komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kaydolması için bir kayıt talebi gönderir.

test_cases.title: Hafızada Radyo Ağı tipi yokken varsayılan tipin kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hafızada Radyo Ağı tipi bulunmamaktadır (ilk güç açılışı veya sistem hatası sonrası). Araca yüklü varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipi yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipi 'GSM-R' olarak yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: OBU güç açılır ve Radyo Ağı tipi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, hafızada tip bulunmadığı için araçta yapılandırılmış varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipini kullanır.

test_cases.title: Kayıtlı olmayan radyo sistemi ile RBC oturumu talebinin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. Depolanan Radyo Ağı tipi GSM-R'dir. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ancak GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kayıtlı değildir (örneğin sinyal yok).
test_cases.test_inputs: Yol kenarından gelen RBC oturumu kurma komutu.

steps.action: Yol kenarı sisteminden RBC ile oturum kurma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, gerekli radyo sisteminin (GSM-R) kayıtlı olmaması nedeniyle güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu talebinde bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Kayıtlı GSM-R terminal yokken RIU oturumu talebinin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlı değildir veya GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na düzgünce kayıtlı değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yol kenarından gelen RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu.

steps.action: Yol kenarı sisteminden RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma komutu gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kayıtlı olmaması nedeniyle güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu talebinde bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduğunda 'Connection Up' göstergesinin kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma sürecini başarıyla tamamlamıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Sürücü arayüzünde bağlantı durumu göstergesi aktif ve okunabilir durumdadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduktan sonra sürücü arayüzündeki bağlantı durumu göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'Connection Up' durumu görüntülenir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı yokken 'No Connection' göstergesinin kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile herhangi bir güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurmamıştır veya bağlantı tamamen kesilmiştir.
test_cases.assumptions: Sürücü arayüzünde bağlantı durumu göstergesi aktif ve okunabilir durumdadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC/RIU ile bağlantısı olmadığı bir durumda sürücü arayüzündeki bağlantı durumu göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'No Connection' durumu görüntülenir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı kaybında 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' göstergesinin kontrolü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile aktif bir güvenli radyo bağlantısına sahiptir.
test_cases.assumptions: Bağlantı kaybı simüle edilebilir veya doğal olarak oluşabilir.

steps.action: Aktif olan güvenli radyo bağlantısı kesilir veya bağlantı kurulumu başarısız olur.
steps.expected: Sürücü arayüzündeki bağlantı durumu göstergesi 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumuna geçer.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu için ilk istek gönderildiğinde zamanlayıcının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile oturum kurmak için SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4) b) ila e) tetikleyicilerinden birini kullanmaya hazırdır.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının durumu izlenebilir (log veya debug arayüzü).

steps.action: OBU, RBC/RIU ile oturum kurmak için ilk güvenli radyo bağlantı kurulum isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU'nun bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının başlatıldığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Oturum sürdürme için ilk istek gönderildiğinde zamanlayıcının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile oturum sürdürmek için SUBSET-026 §3.5.4.2 veya §3.5.4.4 tetikleyicilerini kullanmaya hazırdır.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının durumu izlenebilir (log veya debug arayüzü).

steps.action: OBU, RBC/RIU ile oturum sürdürmek için ilk güvenli radyo bağlantı kurulum isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU'nun bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının başlatıldığı gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: Geçerli durum geçişlerinin kontrolü (No Connection -> Connection Up)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile 'No Connection' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1 ve Tablo 2'de tanımlı geçiş koşulları sağlanabilir.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de 'No Connection' durumundan 'Connection Up' durumuna geçişi sağlayan koşullar sağlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlantı durumu göstergesini 'Connection Up' durumuna değiştirir.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz durum geçişinin engellenmesi (No Connection -> Connection Lost)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile 'No Connection' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de 'No Connection' durumundan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumuna doğrudan geçişin tanımlı olmadığı varsayılır.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'de 'No Connection' durumundan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumuna doğrudan geçişi tetikleyecek bir olay simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlantı durumu göstergesini 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumuna değiştirmez; durum 'No Connection' olarak kalır.

test_cases.title: Birden fazla RIU bağlantısında mevcut dolgu alanına ait durumun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, birden fazla Radio Infill Unit (RIU) ile güvenli radyo bağlantısına sahiptir.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun mevcut dolgu alanı (infill area) belirlenebilir ve farklı RIU'lara ait bağlantı durumları farklıdır.

steps.action: OBU'nun mevcut dolgu alanına ait RIU'nun bağlantı durumu 'Connection Up' iken, diğer bir RIU'nun bağlantı durumu 'No Connection' olarak ayarlanır.
steps.expected: Sürücü arayüzünde, mevcut dolgu alanına ait RIU'nun bağlantı durumu olan 'Connection Up' gösterilir.

test_cases.title: LRBG geçişinde geçersiz konumun geçerli konumla değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun bilinmediği veya geçersiz olduğu bir durumda çalışmaktadır. Araca kayıtlı bir geçersiz tren konumu bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: LRBG sinyali geçiş verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG geçiş algılama sensörleri ve OBU içi konum güncelleme mekanizması aktif ve çalışır durumdadır.

steps.action: Tren, LRBG (Line Route Balise Group) üzerinden geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, LRBG'den gelen geçerli tren konumunu araçta depolanan konum olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'daki depolanan tren konumu durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Önceden depolanmış geçersiz tren konumu silinmiş ve yeni geçerli konum aktif olarak kullanılmaktadır.

test_cases.title: ORBG geçişinde geçersiz konumun geçerli konumla değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun bilinmediği veya geçersiz olduğu bir durumda çalışmaktadır. Araca kayıtlı bir geçersiz tren konumu bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: ORBG (On-Route Balise Group) geçiş verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: ORBG geçiş algılama sensörleri ve OBU içi konum güncelleme mekanizması aktif ve çalışır durumdadır.

steps.action: Tren, ORBG üzerinden geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, ORBG'den gelen geçerli tren konumunu araçta depolanan konum olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'daki depolanan tren konumu durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Önceden depolanmış geçersiz tren konumu silinmiş ve yeni geçerli konum aktif olarak kullanılmaktadır.

test_cases.title: Aktif kabin varken tren yönünün belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trende birden fazla kabin bulunmaktadır. Kabin A aktif, Kabin B pasif durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kabin A aktiflik sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: Kabin aktiflik durumu OBU tarafından doğru şekilde algılanmaktadır.

steps.action: Kabin A'nın aktif olduğu durum OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, tren yönünü Kabin A'nın bulunduğu taraf olarak tanımlar.

steps.action: Tren yönü parametresi kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Trenin ön ucu Kabin A yönünde olarak işaretlenmiştir.

test_cases.title: Aktif kabin yokken son aktif kabine göre yön belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trende birden fazla kabin bulunmaktadır. Son olarak Kabin B aktif idi, ardından Kabin B de pasife alındı. Şu an hiçbir kabin aktif değil.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tüm kabinlerin pasiflik sinyalleri.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, son aktif kabin bilgisini hafızasında tutmaktadır.

steps.action: Tüm kabinlerin pasif olduğu durum OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, tren yönünü son olarak aktif olan Kabin B'nin bulunduğu taraf olarak tanımlar.

steps.action: Tren yönü parametresi kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Trenin ön ucu Kabin B yönünde olarak işaretlenmiştir.

test_cases.title: Konum tabanlı denetimde tahmini ön uç konumunun referans olarak kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, konum tabanlı bir bilgiyi denetlemektedir (örneğin, bir sinyal geçiş denetimi). SUBSET-026'da bu fonksiyon için özel bir referans (maksimum güvenli ön uç veya minimum güvenli arka uç) belirtilmemiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu OBU tarafından doğru şekilde hesaplanmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU, konum tabanlı denetim fonksiyonunu çalıştırır.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim hesabında tren konumu referansı olarak tahmini ön uç konumunu kullanır.

steps.action: Denetim sonucu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Sonuç, tahmini ön uç konumuna göre hesaplanmıştır.

test_cases.title: End Section timer denetiminde maksimum güvenli ön uç konumunun kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, End Section timer denetimi yapmaktadır. SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6'ya göre bu fonksiyon için maksimum güvenli ön uç (max safe front end) referans olarak belirtilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin maksimum güvenli ön uç konumu verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Maksimum güvenli ön uç konumu OBU tarafından doğru şekilde hesaplanmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU, End Section timer denetimini çalıştırır.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim hesabında tren konumu referansı olarak maksimum güvenli ön uç konumunu kullanır.

steps.action: Denetim sonucu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Sonuç, maksimum güvenli ön uç konumuna göre hesaplanmıştır.

test_cases.title: Seviye geçiş sınırı denetiminde minimum güvenli arka uç konumunun kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, seviye geçiş sınırı (level transition border) denetimi yapmaktadır. SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6'ya göre bu fonksiyon için minimum güvenli arka uç (min safe rear end) referans olarak belirtilmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin minimum güvenli arka uç konumu verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: Minimum güvenli arka uç konumu OBU tarafından doğru şekilde hesaplanmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU, seviye geçiş sınırı denetimini çalıştırır.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim hesabında tren konumu referansı olarak minimum güvenli arka uç konumunu kullanır.

steps.action: Denetim sonucu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Sonuç, minimum güvenli arka uç konumuna göre hesaplanmıştır.

test_cases.title: Report position to RBC referring to last passed compliant LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A compliant LRBG (Balise Group) has been passed. The RBC is connected and ready to receive position reports.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data, LRBG ID of the last passed compliant balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8 for compliance are met for the selected LRBG.

steps.action: Move the train past a compliant LRBG (Balise Group) that meets the conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies the LRBG as the last passed compliant group.

steps.action: Trigger a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC referencing the ID of the last passed compliant LRBG.

test_cases.title: Accept trackside information referring to recently reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has recently reported a position to the RBC referencing a specific LRBG (LRBG_A). The RBC sends trackside information (e.g., movement authority) referencing LRBG_A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside information message from RBC referencing LRBG_A.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG_A is within the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: Receive trackside information from the RBC that references LRBG_A.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the trackside information and processes it without error.

test_cases.title: Reject trackside information referring to LRBG outside recent history
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has reported positions referencing a set of recent LRBGs. An LRBG (LRBG_OLD) is not in the set of recently reported LRBGs defined by the minimum number in SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside information message from RBC referencing LRBG_OLD.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG_OLD is older than the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs allowed.

steps.action: Receive trackside information from the RBC that references LRBG_OLD.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the trackside information or raises an error, as the referenced LRBG is not within the allowed recent history.

test_cases.title: Compliance check for linked LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: A LRBG is marked as linked and announced in linking. Linking consistency check is enabled.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data indicating linked status and consistency.
test_cases.assumptions: The LRBG meets the linking consistency conditions.

steps.action: Pass a LRBG that is linked and announced in linking, with consistent linking data.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the LRBG compliant and uses it as the reference for position reporting.

test_cases.title: Compliance check for unlinked LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: A LRBG is not marked as unlinked (i.e., it is either linked or the linking consistency check is not applicable/failed in a way that doesn't mark it unlinked).
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data indicating the LRBG is not marked as unlinked.
test_cases.assumptions: The LRBG is not explicitly marked as unlinked.

steps.action: Pass a LRBG that is not marked as unlinked.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the LRBG compliant and uses it as the reference for position reporting.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information invalid for train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and the train orientation is set to 'Forward'.
test_cases.test_inputs: A transmission medium (e.g., balise) sends a data packet containing information valid only for 'Reverse' orientation.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet from the trackside device that is valid only for the 'Reverse' train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the packet but ignores the information, as it is not valid for the current 'Forward' orientation.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state or output for any application of the received 'Reverse' data.
steps.expected: No changes are made to the OBU's operational parameters based on the ignored data.

test_cases.title: OBU accepts information valid for train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode and the train orientation is set to 'Forward'.
test_cases.test_inputs: A transmission medium sends a data packet containing information valid for 'Forward' orientation.

steps.action: Transmit a data packet from the trackside device that is valid for the 'Forward' train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts and processes the information.

steps.action: Verify the OBU's response or state change corresponding to the accepted data.
steps.expected: The OBU updates its state or outputs the expected result based on the valid 'Forward' data.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., balise group crossing direction is unknown).
test_cases.test_inputs: A transmission medium sends data valid in one direction only.

steps.action: Configure the OBU such that the train orientation is unknown relative to the trackside device direction.
steps.expected: The OBU is in a state where orientation is indeterminate.

steps.action: Transmit data from the trackside device that is valid in one direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

steps.action: Verify that the rejected data is not used for any operational decision.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the rejected one-direction data.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates data valid in both directions when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., balise group crossing direction is unknown).
test_cases.test_inputs: A transmission medium sends data valid in both directions.

steps.action: Configure the OBU such that the train orientation is unknown relative to the trackside device direction.
steps.expected: The OBU is in a state where orientation is indeterminate.

steps.action: Transmit data from the trackside device that is valid in both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates and accepts the data.

steps.action: Verify that the OBU processes the data as expected.
steps.expected: The OBU updates its state or outputs the expected result based on the bidirectional data.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets continuous profile data with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is ready to receive continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A sequence of continuous profile values: [10, 20, 30] with distances [5, 10, 15].
test_cases.assumptions: Previously received data is 0 for the first distance.

steps.action: Transmit the first value 10 with distance 5.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value 10 over the first 5 units of distance.

steps.action: Transmit the second value 20 with distance 10.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value 20 over the next 10 units of distance (from 5 to 15).

steps.action: Transmit the third value 30 with distance 15.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value 30 over the next 15 units of distance (from 15 to 30).

test_cases.title: OBU interprets continuous profile data with last value applying without limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is ready to receive continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A sequence of continuous profile values: [10, 20] with distances [5, 10].
test_cases.assumptions: Previously received data is 0 for the first distance.

steps.action: Transmit the first value 10 with distance 5.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value 10 over the first 5 units of distance.

steps.action: Transmit the second value 20 with distance 10.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value 20 over the next 10 units of distance (from 5 to 15).

steps.action: Check the OBU's profile beyond distance 15.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value 20 without limit beyond distance 15, as it is the last value and not an end-of-profile value.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets continuous profile data with zero distance
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is ready to receive continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A sequence of continuous profile values: [10, 20] with distances [5, 0].
test_cases.assumptions: Previously received data is 0 for the first distance.

steps.action: Transmit the first value 10 with distance 5.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value 10 over the first 5 units of distance.

steps.action: Transmit the second value 20 with distance 0.
steps.expected: The OBU takes value 20 into account, even though the distance is zero.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets location data with unsigned incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is ready to receive location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A sequence of location data values: [100, 200] with distances [10, 20].
test_cases.assumptions: Previously received data is 0 for the first distance.

steps.action: Transmit the first value 100 with distance 10.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value 100 starting from the previously received data (0) over the first 10 units of distance.

steps.action: Transmit the second value 200 with distance 20.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value 200 starting from the end of the previous value (10) over the next 20 units of distance.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets non-continuous profile data with overlapping elements
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is ready to receive non-continuous profile data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A set of elements: [(10, 5), (20, 10)] with starts [0, 3].
test_cases.assumptions: Previously received data is 0 for the first start.

steps.action: Transmit the first element (10, 5) with start 0.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value 10 for length 5 starting from the previously received data (0).

steps.action: Transmit the second element (20, 10) with start 3.
steps.expected: The OBU applies value 20 for length 10 starting from distance 3, allowing overlap with the first element.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets linking information for balise groups
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is ready to receive linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking data: [BG1, BG2] with distances [100, 50].

steps.action: Transmit the first distance 100 and linking data BG1.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets 100 as the distance to the first announced balise group (BG1).

steps.action: Transmit the second distance 50 and linking data BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets 50 as the distance between the first (BG1) and second (BG2) announced balise groups.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A balise group (BG-A) is detected. Linking information is available and contains location accuracy for BG-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information with location accuracy = 10m for BG-A.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the determined location accuracy for the current reference balise group for observation.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG-A and process the associated linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of BG-A as 10m from the linking information.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is not available
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A balise group (BG-B) is detected. No linking information is available for BG-B. A National Value for location accuracy is defined for the current area.
test_cases.test_inputs: National Value for location accuracy = 20m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the determined location accuracy for the current reference balise group for observation.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG-B and allow it to become the LRBG/ORBG without linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of BG-B as 20m from the applicable National Value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A balise group (BG-C) is detected. No linking information is available for BG-C. No National Value for location accuracy is defined for the current area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Default Value for location accuracy = 30m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the determined location accuracy for the current reference balise group for observation.

steps.action: Detect balise group BG-C and allow it to become the LRBG/ORBG without linking or National Value.
steps.expected: The OBU determines the location accuracy of BG-C as 30m from the Default Value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated by further linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy of the current reference balise group (BG-A) as 10m from initial linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information with location accuracy = 15m for BG-A.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the determined location accuracy for the current reference balise group for observation.

steps.action: Receive new linking information for BG-A with a different location accuracy value.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previously determined location accuracy of 10m for BG-A and does not update it to 15m.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy of the current reference balise group (BG-A) as 10m. Linking consistency checking is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger condition to stop checking linking consistency.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the determined location accuracy for the current reference balise group for observation.

steps.action: Stop checking linking consistency for the current balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previously determined location accuracy of 10m for BG-A.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated when new National Values become applicable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has determined the location accuracy of the current reference balise group (BG-A) as 10m. The train moves into an area where a new National Value (25m) becomes applicable.
test_cases.test_inputs: Change of area triggering new National Value applicability.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the determined location accuracy for the current reference balise group for observation.

steps.action: Move the train into an area where a new National Value for location accuracy becomes applicable.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the previously determined location accuracy of 10m for BG-A and does not update it to the new National Value.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation without consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a situation where consist length uncertainty is not applicable. Location accuracy of reference BG is 10m. Over-reading amount is 5m. Under-reading amount is 5m. Estimated front end position is 1000m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location accuracy = 10m, Over-reading = 5m, Under-reading = 5m, Estimated position = 1000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the min and max safe front end positions for observation.

steps.action: Process the location data to calculate the confidence interval.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is calculated as 1000m - 10m - 5m = 985m. The max safe front end is calculated as 1000m + 10m + 5m = 1015m.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation with consist length uncertainty
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a consist-length-related situation defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.4.1.5. Location accuracy of reference BG is 10m. Over-reading amount is 5m. Under-reading amount is 5m. Consist length uncertainty is 2m. Estimated front end position is 1000m.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location accuracy = 10m, Over-reading = 5m, Under-reading = 5m, Consist length uncertainty = 2m, Estimated position = 1000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the min and max safe front end positions for observation.

steps.action: Process the location data to calculate the confidence interval including consist length uncertainty.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is calculated as 1000m - 10m - 5m - 2m = 983m. The max safe front end is calculated as 1000m + 10m + 5m + 2m = 1017m.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is being checked. Balise group BG-1 was received earlier. Balise group BG-2 is received and is announced in linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information announcing BG-2.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the current SOLR identifier for observation.

steps.action: Receive balise group BG-2 which is announced in linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU sets BG-2 as the Single On-board Location Reference (SOLR).

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not being checked. Balise group BG-1 was received earlier. Balise group BG-2 is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG-2 data.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the current SOLR identifier for observation.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items using travelled distance

test_cases.title: Replacement of track description from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Stored track description exists for a section starting at location L1 and ending at L3. New track description is received for a section starting at L2 and ending at L4.
test_cases.test_inputs: New track description message with start location L2.
test_cases.assumptions: L2 is within the range of the previously stored track description.

steps.action: Send new track description message to OBU.
steps.expected: OBU receives the message.

steps.action: Query OBU for track description data between L1 and L2.
steps.expected: The original stored data is retained.

steps.action: Query OBU for track description data between L2 and L4.
steps.expected: The new data is stored and replaces the old data in this range.

steps.action: Query OBU for track description data beyond L4.
steps.expected: The original stored data (if any) is retained or the section is empty as per previous state, not overwritten by the new message.

test_cases.title: Complete replacement of track description
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Stored track description exists for a section starting at L1 and ending at L3.

steps.action: Send new track description message to OBU.
steps.expected: OBU receives the message.

steps.action: Query OBU for track description data in the range L1 to L3.
steps.expected: The new data is stored.

steps.action: Query OBU for track description data outside the new message range but within the old range (if applicable) or verify no residual old data remains where new data applies.
steps.expected: Old data is completely replaced by the new data for the specified type.

steps.action: Query OBU for track condition type data beyond L_target.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with matching validity direction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Train orientation is Forward. Location based information is stored. A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation is received with validity direction Forward.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction Forward.
test_cases.assumptions: The authorisation contains new location based information.

steps.action: Send Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction Forward to OBU.
steps.expected: OBU receives the authorisation.

steps.action: Query OBU for location based information.
steps.expected: The normal replacement rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 are applied. The new information is stored according to these rules (e.g., replacing existing data in the specified range).

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite validity direction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Train orientation is Forward. Location based information is stored. A Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation is received with validity direction Backward.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction Backward.
test_cases.assumptions: The authorisation contains new location based information.

steps.action: Send Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction Backward to OBU.
steps.expected: OBU receives the authorisation.

steps.action: Query OBU for location based information.
steps.expected: The normal replacement rules are NOT applied. All previously stored location based information is deleted.

test_cases.title: MA request includes all applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and connected to RBC. Multiple MA request conditions are active simultaneously (e.g., Section timer expired and track description deletion).
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulate conditions that trigger multiple MA request reasons defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.1.1.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC or a test tool can capture and decode the MA request message to verify the content of the 'MA request reasons' field.

steps.action: Trigger a condition that generates a specific MA request reason (e.g., Section timer expiry).
steps.expected: OBU prepares an MA request.

steps.action: Trigger a second condition that generates a different MA request reason (e.g., track description deletion) before the request is sent.
steps.expected: OBU updates the pending MA request context to include the new reason.

steps.action: Allow the OBU to send the MA request to the RBC.
steps.expected: The sent MA request message contains both the first and the second MA request reason in the appropriate field.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation-location criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A valid MA is active. The perturbation-location criterion is defined in the current MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data simulating the train front passing the calculated perturbation location.
test_cases.assumptions: The perturbation location is calculated based on the current MA parameters and is known to the test setup.

steps.action: Move the train front to a position just before the perturbation location.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Move the train front to pass the perturbation location.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A valid MA is active. The Section timer or LOA speed timer is running.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time progression or speed data to reach the timer limit defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.2.1.
test_cases.assumptions: The timer value is known and can be monitored or accelerated in the test environment.

steps.action: Allow the Section timer (or LOA speed timer) to run until just before the limit is reached.
steps.expected: No MA request is sent to the RBC.

steps.action: Allow the timer to reach the limit defined by the criterion.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request on track description deletion (valid situation)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A valid MA is active. The track description contains data that can be deleted.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message or internal event causing deletion of track description under a situation listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4, excluding a, b, f, and k (e.g., situation c).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation chosen (e.g., c) is one that requires an MA request according to the requirement.

steps.action: Simulate the deletion of a part of the track description under a valid situation (not a, b, f, or k).
steps.expected: The OBU detects the deletion.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior towards RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No MA request on track description deletion (excluded situation)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A valid MA is active. The track description contains data that can be deleted.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message or internal event causing deletion of track description under situation 'a' (or b, f, or k) from SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.assumptions: Situation 'a' is explicitly excluded from triggering an MA request by the requirement.

steps.action: Simulate the deletion of a part of the track description under situation 'a'.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the deletion.

steps.action: Observe OBU behavior towards RBC for a sufficient period.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT send an MA request to the RBC solely due to this deletion.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where End Section timer is applicable. Trackside has sent an End Section timer start location ahead of the train's current position.
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer start location: 1000m ahead of current position. Train speed: 50 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the state of the End Section timer.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end is just before the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer is not started (state: inactive or 0).

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. Trackside has provided a time-out value (e.g., 10 seconds). The current MA includes location-based information and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer time-out value: 10 seconds. Current train position: 500m. End of MA position: 1000m. Target speed at End of MA: 80 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the MA structure, target speeds, and location-based information status.

steps.action: Wait for the End Section timer to exceed the time-out value (10 seconds).
steps.expected: The OBU withdraws the EOA/LOA to the train's current position (500m).

steps.action: Check the location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The relevant location-based information is deleted.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the new End of Movement Authority (current position).
steps.expected: The target speed is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A new MA message is received from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message timestamp: T0. LOA speed timer time-out value: 30 seconds.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the start time of the LOA speed timer.

steps.action: Receive the MA message at time T0.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at time T0.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 1. The train is approaching a balise group that provides the MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group location: 200m ahead. Train speed: 30 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the start time of the LOA speed timer.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the first balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment the train passes the first balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: LOA speed timer is running. Trackside has provided a time-out value (e.g., 30 seconds). The current MA is a LOA with a non-zero speed.
test_cases.test_inputs: LOA speed timer time-out value: 30 seconds. LOA speed: 100 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the MA type, speed, and location-based information status.

steps.action: Wait for the LOA speed timer to exceed the time-out value (30 seconds).
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero.

steps.action: Check the MA type.
steps.expected: The LOA becomes an EOA with the Supervised Location defined as per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5.

steps.action: Check the location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The relevant location-based information is deleted.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where Overlap timer is applicable. Trackside has sent an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train's current position.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer start location: 500m ahead of current position. Train speed: 40 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the state of the Overlap timer.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end is just before the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is not started.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where Overlap timer is applicable. Trackside has sent an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train's current position and a time-out value of 'infinite'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer start location: 500m ahead. Time-out value: infinite.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the state of the Overlap timer.

steps.action: Move the train such that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is regarded as started (state: active), even though the time-out value is infinite.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. Trackside has provided a time-out value (e.g., 20 seconds). The current MA includes an overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer time-out value: 20 seconds. Overlap release speed: 50 km/h. Target speed at End of MA: 80 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the MA structure, overlap status, target speeds, and location-based information status.

steps.action: Wait for the Overlap timer to exceed the time-out value (20 seconds).
steps.expected: The overlap and its associated release speed are deleted.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is redetermined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5.

steps.action: Check the location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The relevant location-based information is deleted.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The target speed is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The train is moving.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 10 km/h. Overlap timer time-out value: 60 seconds.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the Overlap timer state and the consequences of its expiration.

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill (speed = 0) while the Overlap timer is running.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Overlap timer as expired.

steps.action: Check the consequences applied.
steps.expected: The consequences defined for Overlap time-out in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 are applied (e.g., overlap deletion, Supervised Location redetermination, target speed set to zero).

test_cases.title: Overlap timer considered expired if start location is behind max safe front end
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is currently running. The train's max safe front end is at position 1000m.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA with Overlap timer start location: 500m (behind max safe front end).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the Overlap timer state and the consequences of its expiration.

steps.action: Receive a new MA with an Overlap timer start location (500m) that is in rear of the max safe front end (1000m).
steps.expected: The OBU considers that the Overlap timer has exceeded its time-out value.

steps.action: Check the consequences applied.
steps.expected: The consequences defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.4.2 are applied.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with valid overlap
test_cases.preconditions: The MA includes an overlap that has not timed out. A Danger Point and an End of End Section also exist.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap end position: 1500m. Danger Point position: 1200m. End of End Section position: 1000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the Supervised Location.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the end of the overlap (1500m).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with timed-out overlap and valid Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The MA includes an overlap that has timed out. A Danger Point exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Danger Point position: 1200m. End of End Section position: 1000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the Supervised Location.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the Danger Point (1200m).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no overlap and no Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The MA does not include an overlap. No Danger Point exists. An End of End Section exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: End of End Section position: 1000m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the Supervised Location.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is set to the end of the End Section (1000m).

test_cases.title: RBC'den gelen yeni MA ile önceki MA verilerinin tamamen değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC'den gelen geçerli bir MA (MA_old) ile çalışmaktadır ve bu MA'nın verileri bellekte saklanmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen yeni bir MA (MA_new) mesajı.
test_cases.assumptions: MA_new, MA_old'dan farklı bir hareket izni tanımı içermektedir.

steps.action: RBC'den MA_new mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA_new mesajını alır ve işler.

steps.action: OBU'nun bellekteki MA verileri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: MA_old'a ait tüm veriler silinmiş ve MA_new'in verileri ile değiştirilmiştir.

test_cases.title: Ana sinyal baliz grubundan gelen yeni MA ile önceki MA verilerinin tamamen değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ile çalışmaktadır. Araç, ana sinyal baliz grubuna yaklaşmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ana sinyal baliz grubundan (non-infill) gelen yeni bir MA mesajı.
test_cases.assumptions: Baliz grubu, ana sinyal konumunda yer almaktadır.

steps.action: Araç, ana sinyal baliz grubunu okur ve yeni MA mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, baliz grubundan gelen MA mesajını alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun bellekteki MA verileri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Önceki MA'nın tüm verileri silinmiş ve yeni MA'nın verileri ile değiştirilmiştir.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile sadece sonraki ana sinyal baliz grubundan sonraki verilerin değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ile çalışmaktadır. Infill baliz grubu okunmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill baliz grubundan gelen yeni bir MA mesajı (infill information).
test_cases.assumptions: Infill MA, mevcut MA'nın bir kısmını günceller ve sonraki ana sinyal baliz grubuna kadar olan bölümü etkiler.

steps.action: Infill baliz grubundan gelen MA mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, infill MA mesajını alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun bellekteki MA verileri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Infill konumundan sonraki ana sinyal baliz grubuna kadar olan veriler güncellenmiştir. Infill konumundan önceki veriler ve sonraki ana sinyal baliz grubundan sonraki veriler (yeni MA'da tanımlı değilse) korunmuştur veya sadece belirtilen bölge değiştirilmiştir.

test_cases.title: Infill MA alınması durumunda yeni MA bölümünün infill konumunda başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ile çalışmaktadır. Infill baliz grubu okunmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill baliz grubundan gelen MA mesajı.
test_cases.assumptions: Infill konumu, sonraki ana sinyal baliz grubuna karşılık gelmektedir.

steps.action: Infill MA mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, infill MA mesajını işler.

steps.action: OBU'nun MA bölümü başlangıç referansı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Yeni MA bölümü, infill konum referansında (sonraki ana sinyal baliz grubu) başlatılmıştır.

test_cases.title: LOA denetimi sırasında SvL tanımlayan yeni MA'nın MA kısaltılması olarak işlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir LOA (Limit of Authority) denetimi yapmaktadır. Bellekte SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4'te listelenen konum tabanlı bilgiler saklanmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: SvL (Stop at Limit) tanımlayan yeni bir MA mesajı.
test_cases.assumptions: SvL, mevcut LOA'nın içinde veya dışında herhangi bir konumda olabilir.

steps.action: SvL tanımlayan yeni MA mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.

steps.action: OBU'nun MA kısaltılması davranışı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni MA'yı her zaman MA kısaltılması olarak işler.

steps.action: Bellekteki konum tabanlı bilgiler kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4'te listelenen konum tabanlı bilgiler uygun şekilde silinmiştir.

test_cases.title: Yeniden konumlandırma bilgisinin MA kısaltılması olarak değerlendirilmemesi

test_cases.test_inputs: Yeniden konumlandırma (repositioning) bilgisi içeren mesaj.
test_cases.assumptions: Yeniden konumlandırma bilgisi, aracın konumunu güncellemek için kullanılır.

steps.action: Yeniden konumlandırma bilgisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeniden konumlandırma bilgisini alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun MA kısaltılması davranışı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu bilgiyi MA kısaltılması olarak değerlendirmez. Mevcut MA verileri korunur.

test_cases.title: LOA ile sonlanan yeni MA'nın MA kısaltılması olarak değerlendirilmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ile çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: LOA (Limit of Authority) ile sonlanan yeni bir MA mesajı.
test_cases.assumptions: Yeni MA, mevcut MA'nın bir devamı veya güncellemesi olarak gönderilmiştir.

steps.action: LOA ile sonlanan yeni MA mesajı OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni MA mesajını alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun MA kısaltılması davranışı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu MA'yı MA kısaltılması olarak değerlendirmez. Mevcut MA verileri korunur veya uygun şekilde güncellenir, ancak kısaltma işlemi uygulanmaz.

test_cases.title: Adoption of shortened MA when train is behind Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active. The current MA is valid. The train front end position is known and is located behind the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with a new MA value, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list. Train position set to be behind the Indication supervision limit of the new MA.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or receive a specific RBC message containing the shortened MA parameters. The train position can be set to a specific value relative to the MA limit.

steps.action: Set the train front end position to a point behind the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the current train position.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA with the proposed MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the request.

steps.action: Check the OBU's current MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU adopts the proposed shortened MA, its mode profile, and the SH-area balise group list.

steps.action: Check the communication log or status for the response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that it has adopted the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: Rejection of shortened MA when train is ahead of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active. The current MA is valid. The train front end position is known and is located ahead of (or at) the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with a new MA value, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list. Train position set to be ahead of the Indication supervision limit of the new MA.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate or receive a specific RBC message containing the shortened MA parameters. The train position can be set to a specific value relative to the MA limit.

steps.action: Set the train front end position to a point ahead of the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the current train position.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA with the proposed MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the request.

steps.action: Check the OBU's current MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request and keeps the previous MA, mode profile, and list.

steps.action: Check the communication log or status for the response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that it has rejected the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: Boundary condition: Train exactly at Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where MA management is active. The current MA is valid. The train front end position is known and is located exactly at the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA with a new MA value, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list. Train position set to be exactly at the Indication supervision limit of the new MA.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states 'in rear of' for adoption. Therefore, being exactly at the limit is not 'in rear of', so it should be rejected. This test verifies the boundary interpretation.

steps.action: Set the train front end position to be exactly at the Indication supervision limit of the proposed shortened MA.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the current train position.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA with the proposed MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the request.

steps.action: Check the OBU's current MA, mode profile, and SH-area balise group list.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request and keeps the previous MA, mode profile, and list, as the train is not in rear of the limit.

steps.action: Check the communication log or status for the response to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC that it has rejected the shortened MA.

test_cases.title: OBU'nun desteklemediği infill yayın grubunun yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir balise grubundan gelen ve desteklediği bir infill yayın ortamı (medium) ile yapılandırılmıştır. OBU, bu ortamla ilgili güncel operasyonel bilgiyi (örn. hız limiti, sinyal durumu) işlemektedir.

test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun desteklemediği infill yayın ortamının spesifik tanımları (örn. Medium ID) test ortamında yapılandırılabilir.
