steps.expected: OBU, bu yayını yok sayar (ignore). OBU'nun iç durumu, önceki balise grubundan gelen ve desteklediği infill yayın ortamına ait bilgilerle tutarlı kalır.

steps.action: OBU'nun mevcut operasyonel davranışını gözlemleyin (örn. hız limiti, sinyal durumu, sonraki balise grubuna hazırlık).
steps.expected: OBU, yeni yayını yok saydığı için, önceki balise grubundan aldığı bilgilere göre çalışmaya devam eder. Desteklenmeyen ortamla ilgili herhangi bir hata veya durum değişikliği gözlenmez.

test_cases.title: Desteklenmeyen infill ortamı talebinde OBU'nun hata üretmemesi

test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun hata loglama mekanizması test sırasında izlenebilir.

steps.expected: OBU, yayını yok sayar. OBU'nun hata loglarında, bu durumun bir hata (error) veya uyarı (warning) olarak kaydedilmediği doğrulanır (veya gereksinimdeki 'ignore' ifadesine uygun olarak sessizce geçilir).

steps.action: OBU'nun genel sistem sağlığını ve mevcut operasyonel parametrelerini kontrol edin.
steps.expected: OBU, önceki geçerli bilgilere göre çalışmaya devam eder. Desteklenmeyen ortam talebi, OBU'nun mevcut operasyonunu bozmaz veya durdurmaz.

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has not yet read the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill data from loop, Main signal balise group data.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of distinguishing between infill data and main signal balise group data.

steps.action: Transmit infill information from the loop to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU processes and stores the infill information.

steps.action: Transmit the next main signal balise group data to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU reads and processes the main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit further infill information from the loop to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the further infill information and does not update its state based on it.

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed main signal balise group and ignores subsequent infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has not yet read the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill data from loop, Missed main signal balise group detection trigger.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to detect that the main signal balise group was missed (e.g., timeout or position mismatch).

steps.action: Transmit infill information from the loop to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU processes and stores the infill information.

steps.action: Simulate the condition where the next main signal balise group is missed (e.g., by not transmitting it and triggering the miss detection logic).
steps.expected: OBU detects that the main signal balise group was missed.

steps.action: Transmit further infill information from the loop to the OBU.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the further infill information and does not update its state based on it.

test_cases.title: Girdi değiştiğinde yeniden hesaplamanın yapılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisi alarak hız kısıtlamasını hesaplamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Değişiklik içeren PBD girdi seti (örneğin, eğim veya mesafe değişikliği).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun hesaplama döngüsü izlenebilir.

steps.action: PBD hesaplama girdilerinden biri (örneğin, izin verilen frenleme mesafesi) değiştirilerek yeni bir PBD verisi seti gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, hız kısıtlamasını yeniden hesaplar.

steps.action: Yeni hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması değeri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Hız kısıtlaması, yeni girdi değerlerine göre güncellenmiş ve farklı bir değer alır.

test_cases.title: Hesaplama varsayımlarının (SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4) uygulanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, PBD verisi alarak hız kısıtlamasını hesaplamıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bilinen eğim, frenleme karakteristikleri ve gecikme değerleri içeren PBD verisi.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.4'te belirtilen sabit varsayımlar (hız hatası, işlem gecikmesi vb.) test ortamında bilinen değerlere ayarlanmıştır.

steps.action: Dönen kütle telafili eğim, ray kenarı yapışma profillerini yok sayan (güvenli) yavaşlamalar ve fren engeli/güçsüz bölüm ray koşulları içeren bir PBD verisi seti gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, bu spesifik girdileri kullanarak hesaplama yapar.

steps.action: EBD eğrisinin (ve servis freni PBD için SBD eğrisinin) izin verilen frenleme mesafesinde sıfır hıza ulaştığı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Hesaplama, EBD/SBD eğrisinin izin verilen mesafede 0 hıza ulaştığı varsayımına dayanır.

steps.action: Tahmini ivmelenmenin sıfır olduğu ve sabit hız hatası, işlem gecikmesi, fren geri bildirimi ve tahrik kesme varsayımlarının uygulandığı doğrulanır.
steps.expected: Hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması, bu sabit varsayımları içeren formüle göre elde edilen beklenen değerle eşleşir.

test_cases.title: Acil fren (EBD) tabanlı PBD hız kısıtlamasının hesaplanması
test_cases.preconditions: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin acil fren (EBD) kullanılarak sağlanmasını gerektirmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: EBD tabanlı PBD verisi seti.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki eşitsizlikler ve yuvarlatma kuralı test ortamında bilinen bir referans modelle karşılaştırılabilir.

steps.action: EBD tabanlı PBD verisi seti gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'daki EBD tabanlı eşitsizlikleri sağlayan hızı hesaplar.

steps.action: Hesaplanan hız kısıtlaması değeri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Hız kısıtlaması, eşitsizlikleri sağlayan en yüksek hızın, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6'da belirtildiği gibi aşağı yuvarlatılmış değeridir.

test_cases.title: EBD eşitsizliklerini sağlayan hızın olmaması durumunda sıfır hız kısıtlaması
test_cases.preconditions: Ray kenarı, PBD'nin acil fren (EBD) kullanılarak sağlanmasını gerektirmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: EBD eşitsizliklerini sağlayan hiçbir pozitif hızın olmadığı bir PBD verisi seti (örneğin, çok kısa izin verilen frenleme mesafesi veya aşırı eğim).
test_cases.assumptions: Girdi verileri, SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6 eşitsizliklerini sağlayan bir hızın var olmadığı bir senaryoyu temsil eder.

steps.action: EBD eşitsizliklerini sağlayan bir hızın olmadığı PBD verisi seti gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, hesaplama yapar ve eşitsizlikleri sağlayan bir hız bulamaz.

steps.action: Hız kısıtlaması değeri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Hız kısıtlaması 0 olarak ayarlanır.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is defined in the track database. The train is approaching the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position: 100m before the start of the tunnel stopping area. Tunnel stopping area start position: 0m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly calculates the estimated front end position based on speed and acceleration data.

steps.action: Set the estimated front end position to 100m before the start of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU does not trigger the tunnel stopping area condition.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end position reaches the start of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the start of the tunnel stopping area and activates the corresponding condition.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area end evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. The train is inside a tunnel stopping area. The tunnel stopping area end is defined in the track database.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position: 50m before the end of the tunnel stopping area. Tunnel stopping area end position: 0m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly calculates the estimated front end position based on speed and acceleration data.

steps.action: Set the estimated front end position to 50m before the end of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU maintains the tunnel stopping area condition.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end position passes the end of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the end of the tunnel stopping area and deactivates the corresponding condition.

test_cases.title: Sound horn track condition start evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A sound horn track condition is defined in the track database. The train is approaching the sound horn track condition.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position: 200m before the start of the sound horn track condition. Sound horn track condition start position: 0m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly calculates the estimated front end position based on speed and acceleration data.

steps.action: Set the estimated front end position to 200m before the start of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU does not trigger the sound horn track condition.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end position reaches the start of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the start of the sound horn track condition and activates the corresponding condition.

test_cases.title: Sound horn track condition end evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. The train is inside a sound horn track condition. The sound horn track condition end is defined in the track database.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position: 100m before the end of the sound horn track condition. Sound horn track condition end position: 0m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly calculates the estimated front end position based on speed and acceleration data.

steps.action: Set the estimated front end position to 100m before the end of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU maintains the sound horn track condition.

steps.action: Move the train so that the estimated front end position passes the end of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the end of the sound horn track condition and deactivates the corresponding condition.

test_cases.title: Boundary evaluation at exact start position of tunnel stopping area
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is defined in the track database.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position: exactly at the start of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly calculates the estimated front end position based on speed and acceleration data.

steps.action: Set the estimated front end position to exactly the start of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the start of the tunnel stopping area and activates the corresponding condition.

test_cases.title: Boundary evaluation at exact end position of sound horn track condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. The train is inside a sound horn track condition.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated front end position: exactly at the end of the sound horn track condition.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU correctly calculates the estimated front end position based on speed and acceleration data.

steps.action: Set the estimated front end position to exactly the end of the sound horn track condition.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the end of the sound horn track condition and deactivates the corresponding condition.

test_cases.title: Loading gauge unsuitability detection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and Train Data is stored with a specific loading gauge (e.g., Gauge A). Trackside sends route suitability data permitting only Gauge B.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data: Permitted Loading Gauges = [Gauge B]. Stored Train Data: Loading Gauge = Gauge A.

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the data and initiates the comparison process.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's status regarding route suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU reports an unsuitability due to loading gauge mismatch.

test_cases.title: Axle load category unsuitability detection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and Train Data is stored with a specific axle load category (e.g., Category 1). Trackside sends route suitability data permitting only Category 2.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data: Permitted Axle Load Categories = [Category 2]. Stored Train Data: Axle Load Category = Category 1.

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the data and initiates the comparison process.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's status regarding route suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU reports an unsuitability due to axle load category mismatch.

test_cases.title: Traction system unsuitability detection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and Train Data is stored with an engine that accepts only Traction System X. Trackside sends route suitability data providing Traction System Y.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data: Traction System = Y. Stored Train Data: Accepted Traction Systems = [X].

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the data and initiates the comparison process.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's status regarding route suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU reports an unsuitability due to traction system mismatch.

test_cases.title: No unsuitability when all parameters match
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and Train Data is stored with Loading Gauge A, Axle Load Category 1, and Accepted Traction System X. Trackside sends route suitability data permitting Gauge A, Category 1, and providing Traction System X.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data: Permitted Loading Gauges = [A], Permitted Axle Load Categories = [1], Traction System = X. Stored Train Data: Loading Gauge = A, Axle Load Category = 1, Accepted Traction Systems = [X].

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the data and initiates the comparison process.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's status regarding route suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU does not report any unsuitability.

test_cases.title: No traction unsuitability for engine running without traction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and Train Data is stored with an engine that can run on a line without any traction system. Trackside sends route suitability data with a specific traction system (e.g., System Z).
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data: Traction System = Z. Stored Train Data: Engine capability = Can run without traction system.

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the data and initiates the comparison process.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's status regarding traction system suitability.
steps.expected: The OBU does not report a traction system unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Operation without route suitability data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in its initial state. No route suitability data is transmitted by trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: No route suitability data received.

steps.action: Allow the train to run without receiving any route suitability data from trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU allows the train to run.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for route suitability restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU does not use or supervise any default route suitability values, and its state indicates no route suitability restriction exists.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for auxiliary information without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with class 'auxiliary information' and 'acknowledgement not requested'.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific visual appearance (e.g., font, color, position) for auxiliary information is defined in the OBU HMI specification.

steps.action: Send a text message from trackside with class 'auxiliary information' and no driver acknowledgement request.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message using the appearance defined for auxiliary information.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information with acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with class 'important information' and 'acknowledgement requested'.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific visual appearance (e.g., font, color, position) for important information is defined in the OBU HMI specification.

steps.action: Send a text message from trackside with class 'important information' and driver acknowledgement requested.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the message using the appearance defined for important information.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (OR logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start condition defined as 'Speed > 100 km/h OR Location = 1000m'. Trackside defines logic as 'any'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate speed and location for testing.

steps.action: Set OBU speed to 50 km/h and location to 500m. Send the text message.
steps.expected: The message is not displayed.

steps.action: Increase OBU speed to 120 km/h while location remains 500m.
steps.expected: The start condition is fulfilled (one sub-condition met), and the message is displayed.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (AND logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start condition defined as 'Speed > 100 km/h AND Location = 1000m'. Trackside defines logic as 'all'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can simulate speed and location for testing.

steps.action: Set OBU speed to 120 km/h and location to 500m. Send the text message.
steps.expected: The message is not displayed (only one sub-condition met).

steps.action: Move OBU to location 1000m while speed remains 120 km/h.
steps.expected: The start condition is fulfilled (all sub-conditions met), and the message is displayed.

test_cases.title: Start condition fulfilled immediately when no sub-conditions defined
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with no start sub-conditions defined.

steps.action: Send a text message from trackside that defines none of the start sub-conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start condition as fulfilled immediately and displays the message (assuming end condition is not yet fulfilled).

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message requesting driver confirmation, defined such that acknowledgement always ends display. End condition is 'Location = 2000m'.
test_cases.assumptions: The message is currently displayed.

steps.action: Display the text message. Ensure the end condition (Location = 2000m) is not yet fulfilled (e.g., current location is 1000m).
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The text display ends immediately, even though the end condition is not fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement is necessary condition for ending display
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message requesting driver confirmation, defined such that acknowledgement is a necessary condition in addition to the end condition. End condition is 'Location = 2000m'.
test_cases.assumptions: The message is currently displayed.

steps.action: Display the text message. Move OBU to location 2000m (end condition fulfilled) but do not acknowledge.
steps.expected: The message remains displayed because driver acknowledgement is required.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The text display ends.

test_cases.title: Message not displayed if end condition already fulfilled at start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start condition 'Location = 1000m' and end condition 'Location = 1000m'.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU is currently at location 1000m.

steps.action: Send the text message while OBU is at location 1000m.
steps.expected: The start condition is fulfilled. The OBU evaluates the end condition, which is also fulfilled. The message is not displayed at all.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message with start condition 'Location = 1000m' and end condition 'Location = 1500m' (length 500m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can track location accurately.

steps.action: Send the text message when OBU is at location 1000m.
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Move OBU to location 1500m.
steps.expected: The message display ends, as the end condition (location 1500m) is fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement report sent to RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message requesting a report of driver acknowledgement, with identifier 'MSG-123'.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC is monitoring for acknowledgement reports.

steps.action: Display the text message 'MSG-123'.
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a driver acknowledgement report to the RBC, including the text message identifier 'MSG-123'.

test_cases.title: Reject duplicate text message identifier
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and connected to RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: First text message with identifier 'MSG-456' requesting acknowledgement. Second text message with same identifier 'MSG-456'.

steps.action: Send the first text message with identifier 'MSG-456' requesting acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Send a new text message with the same identifier 'MSG-456' before the driver acknowledges the first one.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the newly received text message.

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile OS/LS Mode Profile'ın referans noktası ötesinde silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir OS/LS Mode Profile'ı aktif olarak izlemektedir. Infill MA, referans konumu (infill reference location) bu Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının ötesinde (önünde) olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA: Referans konumu, OS/LS Mode Profile'ın başlangıcından ötede. Infill MA'da yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise listesi mevcut.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun mevcut izlenen Mode Profile'ı OS/LS tipindedir.

steps.action: OBU'ya referans konumu mevcut OS/LS Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının ötesinde olan bir Infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen OS/LS Mode Profile'ı referans konumuna kadar korur ve referans konumunun ötesindeki kısmı siler.

steps.action: Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesi kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesini yok sayar (ignore).

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile izlenen SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının önünde referans varsa silinmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir SH (Supervised) Mode Profile'ı aktif olarak izlemektedir. Infill MA, referans konumu bu SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcında veya arkasında olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA: Referans konumu, SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcında veya arkasında. Infill MA'da yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise listesi mevcut.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun mevcut izlenen Mode Profile'ı SH tipindedir.

steps.action: OBU'ya referans konumu mevcut SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcında veya arkasında olan bir Infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen SH Mode Profile'ı tamamen siler.

steps.action: Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesi kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesini yok sayar (ignore).

test_cases.title: Infill MA ile izlenen SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının arkasında referans varsa korunması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, izlenen bir SH (Supervised) Mode Profile'ı aktif olarak izlemektedir. Infill MA, referans konumu bu SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının ötesinde (önünde) olacak şekilde gönderilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA: Referans konumu, SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının ötesinde. Infill MA'da yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise listesi mevcut.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun mevcut izlenen Mode Profile'ı SH tipindedir.

steps.action: OBU'ya referans konumu mevcut SH Mode Profile'ın başlangıcının ötesinde olan bir Infill MA gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, izlenen SH Mode Profile'ı silmez ve korur.

steps.action: Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesi kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Infill MA'daki yeni Mode Profile ve SH balise grubu listesini yok sayar (ignore).

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcında geçici EOA ve SvL (release speed yok) - Profile SvL gerektiriyorsa
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir Mode Profile'ı izlemektedir ancak henüz bu moda geçmemiştir. Mode Profile, başlangıç noktasında bir Supervision Level (SvL) gerektirmektedir. MA'da LOA (Limit of Authority) tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile: SvL gerektiriyor. MA: LOA mevcut. OBU durumu: Mode Profile moduna geçiş yapılmamış.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcına yaklaşmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcına ulaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici bir EOA (End of Authority) olarak değerlendirir.

steps.action: OBU'nun hız profili kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcında release speed içermeyen bir geçici SvL (Supervision Level) uygular.

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcında geçici EOA ve SvL (release speed yok) - Profile SvL gerektirmiyorsa ve LOA profile başlangıcında veya ötesinde
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir Mode Profile'ı izlemektedir ancak henüz bu moda geçmemiştir. Mode Profile, başlangıç noktasında bir SvL gerektirmemektedir. MA'da LOA tanımlıdır ve LOA konumu Mode Profile başlangıcında veya ötesindedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile: SvL gerektirmiyor. MA: LOA mevcut, LOA >= Mode Profile başlangıcı. OBU durumu: Mode Profile moduna geçiş yapılmamış.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcına yaklaşmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcına ulaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici bir EOA olarak değerlendirir.

steps.action: OBU'nun hız profili kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, LOA verilmemiş gibi davranarak (SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5'e göre) release speed içermeyen bir geçici SvL uygular.

test_cases.title: Mode Profile başlangıcında geçici EOA ve SvL (release speed yok) - Profile SvL gerektirmiyorsa ve LOA profile başlangıcının arkasında
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bir Mode Profile'ı izlemektedir ancak henüz bu moda geçmemiştir. Mode Profile, başlangıç noktasında bir SvL gerektirmemektedir. MA'da LOA tanımlıdır ve LOA konumu Mode Profile başlangıcının arkasındadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile: SvL gerektirmiyor. MA: LOA mevcut, LOA < Mode Profile başlangıcı. OBU durumu: Mode Profile moduna geçiş yapılmamış.

steps.action: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcına ulaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcını geçici bir EOA olarak değerlendirir.

steps.action: OBU'nun hız profili kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, Mode Profile başlangıcında release speed içermeyen bir geçici SvL uygular.

test_cases.title: LX information replacement with same identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where it can receive LX information. An initial LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-A' is already stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: New LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-B'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to verify the stored LX information content.

steps.action: Verify the currently stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123'.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-A'.

steps.action: Transmit the new LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-B' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new LX information.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-B', confirming the old information was replaced.

test_cases.title: LX information retention with different identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. An initial LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-123' and Data 'Data-A' is already stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: New LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-456' and Data 'Data-C'.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface or log to verify the stored LX information content.

steps.action: Transmit the new LX information packet with Identity ID 'ID-456' and Data 'Data-C' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new LX information.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-123' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data remains 'Data-A', confirming it was not replaced by the different identity.

steps.action: Read the stored LX information for Identity ID 'ID-456' from the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored data is 'Data-C'.

test_cases.title: Government identifier and core attributes validation against authoritative source
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. The user provides a government-issued ID and other core attributes (e.g., name, date of birth) that match the records in the configured authoritative source (e.g., Ministry of Interior database).
test_cases.test_inputs: Government ID number: 12345678901, Name: John Doe, Date of Birth: 1990-01-01, Address: 123 Main St.
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source is accessible and contains matching records for the provided test data.

steps.action: Submit the company representative proofing form with the provided government identifier and core attributes.
steps.expected: The system initiates the validation process against the authoritative source.

steps.action: Wait for the validation process to complete.
steps.expected: The system returns a success status, indicating that all core attributes have been validated.

steps.action: Check the user profile status in the system.
steps.expected: The user profile is marked as 'Verified' or 'Active' with IAL2 assurance level.

test_cases.title: Validation of digitally signed attributes on SUPERIOR evidence
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. The user provides a digitally signed document (e.g., e-Id) classified as SUPERIOR evidence. The issuer's public key is registered in the system's trust store.
test_cases.test_inputs: Digitally signed document: e-Id.pdf (signed with valid issuer key), Issuer: Test Authority.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to accept digitally signed attributes from the specified issuer and the public key is correctly loaded.

steps.action: Upload the digitally signed document containing the core attributes.
steps.expected: The system accepts the document and initiates the digital signature verification process.

steps.action: Wait for the signature verification to complete.
steps.expected: The system verifies the signature using the issuer's public key and confirms the integrity of the attributes.

steps.action: Check the user profile status in the system.
steps.expected: The user profile is marked as 'Verified' or 'Active' with IAL2 assurance level, based on the validated digital attributes.

test_cases.title: Validation failure due to mismatched government identifier
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. The user provides a government-issued ID and core attributes that do NOT match the records in the authoritative source.
test_cases.test_inputs: Government ID number: 99999999999 (not in source), Name: John Doe, Date of Birth: 1990-01-01.
test_cases.assumptions: The authoritative source is accessible and does not contain a record for the provided government ID number.

steps.action: Submit the company representative proofing form with the mismatched government identifier and core attributes.
steps.expected: The system initiates the validation process against the authoritative source.

steps.action: Wait for the validation process to complete.
steps.expected: The system returns a failure status, indicating that the core attributes could not be validated.

steps.action: Check the user profile status in the system.
steps.expected: The user profile remains 'Unverified' or 'Pending', and an error message is displayed to the user.

test_cases.title: Validation failure due to invalid digital signature
test_cases.preconditions: A test user profile is created with IAL2 assurance level. The user provides a digitally signed document classified as SUPERIOR evidence, but the signature is invalid (e.g., tampered with or signed with an untrusted key).
test_cases.test_inputs: Digitally signed document: tampered_e-Id.pdf (invalid signature), Issuer: Test Authority.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to verify digital signatures and the provided document has an invalid or untrusted signature.

steps.action: Upload the digitally signed document with an invalid signature.
steps.expected: The system accepts the document and initiates the digital signature verification process.

steps.action: Wait for the signature verification to complete.
steps.expected: The system fails to verify the signature and returns a failure status.

steps.action: Check the user profile status in the system.
steps.expected: The user profile remains 'Unverified' or 'Pending', and an error message indicating signature validation failure is displayed.
